blank_detector.architecture: MobileNetV3-Small fine-tuned with non-blank weighted loss + camera-trap augmentation
blank_detector.safety_note: High-confidence blank quarantine should remain reversible; model failures must route to review.

tiger_identifier.architecture: Spatial CNN + supervised identity head + Triplet Margin Loss
tiger_identifier.evaluation_note: Metrics are computed from held-out query images; no hardcoded accuracy values.

notes: Tiger detector weights are existing YOLO weights; retraining requires Ultralytics and was not executable in the offline build environment.
Re-ID dataset was cleaned by removing non-tiger crop distractors.
Re-ID metrics are held-out measurements, not hardcoded.
Autonomous identity assignment should remain disabled for ambiguous/low-confidence cases until a larger, genuinely field-collected Re-ID dataset is available.
